description: This file declares the FireboltMediaPlayer class, which is a plugin for media playback in the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for notifications and media stream proxy management, along with function declarations for creating, controlling, and querying media playback. It also defines structure for tracking media streams and plugin lifecycle management.

classes.name: FireboltMediaPlayer
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing media player control and lifecycle management, with nested classes for notification handling and media stream proxy management.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Handles remote connection events for the plugin, such as activation and deactivation, and maintains reference to parent.

classes.name: MediaStreamProxy
classes.description: Proxy representing an out-of-process media stream, with registration and event handling capabilities.

classes.name: MediaStreamSink
classes.description: Internal class within MediaStreamProxy, implementing notification interface for media stream events.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a media player instance based on provided parameters.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a media player instance identified by parameters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media content based on parameters.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the media.

methods.name: onMediaStreamEvent
methods.description: Handles events related to media streams.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin before shutdown.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Provides plugin information as a string.
